scope: Seven SCC and empirical-interface sources. Current source identity against receipt pin. Lexical declaration headers and source axiom requests, not elaborated types or fresh axioms; non-Lean sources separately classified.

declarations.name: AgreesOn
declarations.source_header: def AgreesOn (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Set Obs) (a b : Model) : Prop

declarations.name: SeparatesOn
declarations.source_header: def SeparatesOn (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Set Obs) (a b : Model) : Prop

declarations.name: agrees_refl
declarations.source_header:
theorem agrees_refl (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Set Obs) (a : Model) :
    AgreesOn p S a a

declarations.name: agrees_symm
declarations.source_header:
theorem agrees_symm (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Set Obs) (a b : Model)
    (hab : AgreesOn p S a b) : AgreesOn p S b a

declarations.name: agrees_trans
declarations.source_header:
theorem agrees_trans (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Set Obs) (a b c : Model)
    (hab : AgreesOn p S a b) (hbc : AgreesOn p S b c) :
    AgreesOn p S a c

declarations.name: separation_not_agreement
declarations.source_header:
theorem separation_not_agreement (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (S : Set Obs) (a b : Model) (h : SeparatesOn p S a b) :
    ¬ AgreesOn p S a b

declarations.name: disagreement_has_witness
declarations.source_header:
theorem disagreement_has_witness (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (S : Set Obs) (a b : Model) (h : ¬ AgreesOn p S a b) :
    SeparatesOn p S a b

declarations.name: separation_mono
declarations.source_header:
theorem separation_mono (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (S T : Set Obs) (a b : Model) (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (h : SeparatesOn p S a b) : SeparatesOn p T a b

declarations.name: agreement_antitone
declarations.source_header:
theorem agreement_antitone (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (S T : Set Obs) (a b : Model) (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (h : AgreesOn p T a b) : AgreesOn p S a b

declarations.name: FiniteSeparates
declarations.source_header:
def FiniteSeparates (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Finset Obs)
    (a b : Model) : Prop

declarations.name: finite_separation_mono
declarations.source_header:
theorem finite_separation_mono (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (S T : Finset Obs) (a b : Model) (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (h : FiniteSeparates p S a b) : FiniteSeparates p T a b

declarations.name: DeletionMinimal
declarations.source_header:
def DeletionMinimal (p : Model → Obs → Bool) [DecidableEq Obs]
    (S : Finset Obs) (a b : Model) : Prop

declarations.name: singleton_deletion_minimal
declarations.source_header:
theorem singleton_deletion_minimal (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    [DecidableEq Obs] (a b : Model) (w : Obs)
    (hne : p a w ≠ p b w) :
    DeletionMinimal p ({w} : Finset Obs) a b

declarations.name: distinct_singleton_minimals
declarations.source_header:
theorem distinct_singleton_minimals (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    [DecidableEq Obs] (a b : Model) (w₁ w₂ : Obs)
    (hneq : w₁ ≠ w₂)
    (h₁ : p a w₁ ≠ p b w₁) (h₂ : p a w₂ ≠ p b w₂) :
    DeletionMinimal p ({w₁} : Finset Obs) a b ∧
    DeletionMinimal p ({w₂} : Finset Obs) a b ∧
    ({w₁} : Finset Obs) ≠ ({w₂} : Finset Obs)

declarations.name: UniformlySeparates
declarations.source_header:
def UniformlySeparates (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) (S : Finset Obs) : Prop

declarations.name: uniform_separation_mono
declarations.source_header:
theorem uniform_separation_mono (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) (S T : Finset Obs) (hST : S ⊆ T)
    (h : UniformlySeparates p A B S) : UniformlySeparates p A B T

declarations.name: overlap_blocks_uniform
declarations.source_header:
theorem overlap_blocks_uniform (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) (S : Finset Obs)
    (hab : ∃ x, x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B) :
    ¬ UniformlySeparates p A B S

declarations.name: FullyAgrees
declarations.source_header:
def FullyAgrees (p : Model → Obs → Option Bool)
    (S : Finset Obs) (a b : Model) : Prop

declarations.name: DefinedSeparation
declarations.source_header:
def DefinedSeparation (p : Model → Obs → Option Bool)
    (S : Finset Obs) (a b : Model) : Prop

declarations.name: missing_blocks_agreement
declarations.source_header:
theorem missing_blocks_agreement (p : Model → Obs → Option Bool)
    (S : Finset Obs) (a b : Model) (w : Obs)
    (hw : w ∈ S) (hmissing : p a w = none) :
    ¬ FullyAgrees p S a b

declarations.name: defined_separation_not_agreement
declarations.source_header:
theorem defined_separation_not_agreement (p : Model → Obs → Option Bool)
    (S : Finset Obs) (a b : Model)
    (h : DefinedSeparation p S a b) :
    ¬ FullyAgrees p S a b

declarations.name: UniformDeletionMinimal
declarations.source_header:
def UniformDeletionMinimal (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs) : Prop

declarations.name: uniformDeletionMinimal_iff_minimal
declarations.source_header:
theorem uniformDeletionMinimal_iff_minimal (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs) :
    UniformDeletionMinimal p A B S ↔
      Minimal (UniformlySeparates p A B) S

declarations.name: uniformDeletionMinimal_is_uniform
declarations.source_header:
theorem uniformDeletionMinimal_is_uniform (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs)
    (h : UniformDeletionMinimal p A B S) :
    UniformlySeparates p A B S

declarations.name: equivalent_pair_blocks_uniform
declarations.source_header:
theorem equivalent_pair_blocks_uniform (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) (S : Finset Obs) (a b : Model)
    (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B)
    (heq : ∀ w, w ∈ S → p a w = p b w) :
    ¬ UniformlySeparates p A B S

declarations.name: empty_witnesses_blocked
declarations.source_header:
theorem empty_witnesses_blocked (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) (a b : Model) (ha : a ∈ A) (hb : b ∈ B) :
    ¬ UniformlySeparates p A B (∅ : Finset Obs)

declarations.name: family_minimal_implies_uniform
declarations.source_header:
theorem family_minimal_implies_uniform (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs)
    (h : Minimal (UniformlySeparates p A B) S) :
    UniformlySeparates p A B S

imports: any theorem from the conditional NFC SCC manuscript.

declarations.name: CoveredPairs
declarations.source_header:
def CoveredPairs (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (S : Finset Obs) :
    Set (Model × Model)

declarations.name: uniform_iff_pairwise_cover
declarations.source_header:
theorem uniform_iff_pairwise_cover (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) (S : Finset Obs) :
    UniformlySeparates p A B S ↔
      ∀ pair : Model × Model, pair.1 ∈ A → pair.2 ∈ B →
        pair ∈ CoveredPairs p S

declarations.name: deletion_failure_iff_uncovered_pair
declarations.source_header:
theorem deletion_failure_iff_uncovered_pair (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs]
    (S : Finset Obs) (w : Obs) :
    ¬ UniformlySeparates p A B (S.erase w) ↔
      ∃ a, a ∈ A ∧ ∃ b, b ∈ B ∧
        ∀ v, v ∈ S.erase w → p a v = p b v

declarations.name: PrivatePair
declarations.source_header:
def PrivatePair (p : Model → Obs → Bool) (A B : Set Model)
    [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs) (w : Obs) : Prop

declarations.name: uncovered_pair_yields_private
declarations.source_header:
theorem uncovered_pair_yields_private (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs]
    (S : Finset Obs) (w : Obs)
    (hcover : UniformlySeparates p A B S)
    (hleft : ∃ a, a ∈ A ∧ ∃ b, b ∈ B ∧
      ∀ v, v ∈ S.erase w → p a v = p b v) :
    PrivatePair p A B S w

declarations.name: uniform_minimal_iff_private
declarations.source_header:
theorem uniform_minimal_iff_private (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs) :
    UniformDeletionMinimal p A B S ↔
      UniformlySeparates p A B S ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ S → PrivatePair p A B S w

declarations.name: inclusion_minimal_iff_private
declarations.source_header:
theorem inclusion_minimal_iff_private (p : Model → Obs → Bool)
    (A B : Set Model) [DecidableEq Obs] (S : Finset Obs) :
    Minimal (UniformlySeparates p A B) S ↔
      UniformlySeparates p A B S ∧
        ∀ w, w ∈ S → PrivatePair p A B S w

declarations.name: totalVariation
declarations.source_header: def totalVariation {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n) : ℚ

declarations.name: totalVariation_nonneg
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_nonneg {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n) :
    0 ≤ totalVariation p q

declarations.name: totalVariation_self
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_self {n : ℕ} (p : Categorical n) :
    totalVariation p p = 0

declarations.name: totalVariation_symm
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_symm {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n) :
    totalVariation p q = totalVariation q p

declarations.name: totalVariation_eq_zero_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n) :
    totalVariation p q = 0 ↔ p.weight = q.weight

declarations.name: totalVariation_pos_iff
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_pos_iff {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n) :
    0 < totalVariation p q ↔ p.weight ≠ q.weight

declarations.name: totalVariation_pos_of_witness
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_pos_of_witness {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n)
    (i : Fin n) (hne : p.weight i ≠ q.weight i) :
    0 < totalVariation p q

declarations.name: totalVariation_le_one
declarations.source_header:
theorem totalVariation_le_one {n : ℕ} (p q : Categorical n) :
    totalVariation p q ≤ 1
